title: Juice N Power Bar Salts Juicy Peach 10ml E-Liquid
description: Juicy Peach from the JNP Bar Salts collection provides a bright, velvety, and straightforward fruit profile. This blend focuses entirely on the rich, sun-ripened sweetness of Peach, capturing its distinctive stone fruit character with exceptional clarity. The result is a smooth and intensely flavoursome vape that remains deeply refreshing and consistently authentic. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid nicotine relief and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. These extra-concentrated e-liquids are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. Formulated by the UK brand Juice N Power, the JNP Bar Salts collection takes inspiration from popular bar-style blends to deliver intense, long-lasting flavour in a versatile 10ml format. Offering a comprehensive range of fruit, soda, and confectionery profiles alongside unique mixes, there is a dependable option for every preference. Beyond the vibrant fruit notes of Juicy Peach, vapers can explore other compelling profiles such as the complex Blackcurrant Aniseed or the sunny Caribbean Crush.
